theme-manager.title: Central Theme Manager
theme-manager.subtitle: Color seeds + light/dark with auto-propagation
theme-manager.summary: One resource, six seed colours, every component. Series colours come from a colour-blind-safe palette and the theme can tell you the contrast ratio it achieved.

tutorials.title: Customize the default theme
tutorials.description: The theme manager uses a DVTheme Resource file found here. Each them has a Dark/light mode toggle for easy switching.

tutorials.title: Set the active theme
tutorials.description: The active theme can be updated through the Project settings. (Check the bottom of the list and select your custom resource file.) Or via script.

bar-chart.title: Bar Chart
bar-chart.subtitle: Grouped or stacked bars, with a zero baseline
bar-chart.summary: Categorical bars that read honestly: the value axis includes zero, stacks scale to the stack total, and hover, click and keyboard selection all report the same item.

tutorials.title: Track Engagement by Device
tutorials.description: Populate grouped bars, customize spacing, and listen for hover/click signals.

line-chart.title: Line Chart
line-chart.subtitle: Lines, fills, and 100k points without breaking a sweat
line-chart.summary: Decimates above roughly two samples per pixel column, keeping spikes, so a 100,000-point series costs about what a 1,000-point one does.

tutorials.title: Simple Example
tutorials.description: Here is how easy it is to get a line grid going, and fill the active line.

tutorials.title: Add SMA/EMA Overlays
tutorials.description: Overlays (SMA, EMA,  Bollinger Bands) are enabled per series using an overlay mask that combines OverlayMask flags. Windows are expressed in samples (bars). You can either configure them after adding a series, or use the convenience method that sets everything in one call.

box-plot.title: Box Plot
box-plot.subtitle: Quartiles, whiskers, outliers
box-plot.summary: Visualize spread and skew with automatic quartile computation and optional outlier dots.

tutorials.title: Compare Quartile Spread
tutorials.description: Feed sample returns per sector and inspect medians via the click signal.

waterfall.title: Waterfall
waterfall.subtitle: Step-by-step deltas to a total
waterfall.summary: Shows how individual positives/negatives accumulate from start to finish.

tutorials.title: Build a Cash Flow Bridge
tutorials.description: Convert monthly deltas into a waterfall with currency formatting and totals.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.subtitle: Tracks with events and 'now' marker
timeline.summary: Multi-track time blocks for incidents, quests, or production schedules.

tutorials.title: Plan Story Beats Across Tracks
tutorials.description: Create multiple tracks, add events, and surface interactivity through signals.

gauge.title: Gauge
gauge.subtitle: Arc meter with ticks and center text
gauge.summary: Configurable sweep, round/square caps, and dynamic center label.

tutorials.title: Simple Progressbar
tutorials.description: Nice progressbar with only a couple of lines.

tutorials.title: Monitor Server Load
tutorials.description: Define zones, configure ticks, and respond when the value enters a new range.

pie-chart.title: Pie / Donut
pie-chart.subtitle: Categories with inside/outside labels
pie-chart.summary: Pie chart with leader lines and total-in-center option. And animated hover slices.

tutorials.title: Render a Donut simple Pie
tutorials.description: Simple chart with labels inside, and react to slice clicks.

tutorials.title: Render a Donut with Leader Lines
tutorials.description: Enable donut mode, position labels outside, and react to slice clicks.

kpi-tile.title: KPI Tile
kpi-tile.subtitle: Headline value with delta & sparkline
kpi-tile.summary: Compact metric tile for quick-glance stats; supports icons and trend line.

tutorials.title: Summarize Revenue in a Tile
tutorials.description: Display title, value, delta, and sparkline for a dashboard metric tile.

radar-graph.title: Radar Graph
radar-graph.subtitle: Multi-axial comparison
radar-graph.summary: Plot actor or faction profiles across multiple axes with fill and outline.

tutorials.title: Profile Squad Attributes
tutorials.description: Plot five attributes with a consistent scale and readable grid.

table-grid.title: Table Grid
table-grid.subtitle: Virtualised, sortable, keyboard-navigable
table-grid.summary: Only the visible rows are drawn. Click or arrow through rows, sort by header, and columns share the width instead of stranding it in the last one.

tutorials.title: Populate a Sortable Grid
tutorials.description: Feed columns and rows, enable keyboard nav, and handle cell clicks.

heat-map.title: Heat Map
heat-map.subtitle: Grid intensities with legend
heat-map.summary: Render weighted grids for AI costs, supply/demand, or correlation matrices.

tutorials.title: Visualize Incident Density
tutorials.description: Map world-space coordinates into the heat map and respond to selections.

tutorials.title: Neo City
tutorials.description: Add Stickers to the map for an enhanced interaction. Stickers can be moved in realtime.

detail-panel.title: Detail Panel
detail-panel.subtitle: Grouped key/value panel with bars, pills and inline editors
detail-panel.summary: Fields group under headings, arrays draw as pills, a percentage draws as a bar, and the panel scrolls when there is more than fits.

tutorials.title: Assemble a Character Sheet
tutorials.description: Group DV_Field entries, mix badges and progress, and capture row clicks.

overlays.title: Moving averages & Bollinger Bands
overlays.subtitle: SMA, EMA and BB as per-series overlays
overlays.summary: Hand a series an overlay mask and the window lengths; the chart computes the averages and bands and clips them to the visible range.
